data.exact_reserve_text: During 2017 the Syndicate released GBP 39.4m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2016: GBP 95.7m), arising predominantly from the Energy and Marine Divisions (2016: primarily from the Energy and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2017.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate released GBP 39.4 million of technical reserves in 2017, primarily due to favourable claims development on prior periods, specifically within the Energy and Marine Divisions. The report also highlights significant catastrophe events in 2017, including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, Mexican earthquakes, and California wildfires, which resulted in estimated ultimate net claims of GBP 99.3 million. Prior year events from 2016, such as the Fort McMurray wildfire and the New Zealand earthquake, also had ultimate net claims of GBP 6.3 million and GBP 6.6 million respectively.

inwards reinstatement premiums received this year are notably higher following the loss activity noted earlier
mark-to-market losses following an upwards shift in yield curves
